title: UpPoomPak
tagline: UpPoom's Rest Day : a program that will take everyone to "rest" in Up and Poom's
synopsis: UpPoom's Rest Day : a program that will take everyone to "rest" in Up and Poom's style.

trailers.title: [TEASER] UP POOM พัก | วันพักของอัพภูมิ

episodes.title: EP.1 | Stay in a luxurious hotel in the heart of the city (1/2)
episodes.synopsis: The first episode, Up Poom takes us to stay at a luxurious hotel in the heart of Bangkok. At Anantara Siam Bangkok Hotel, a 5-star hotel in the heart of the city, which has everything from restaurants, cafes, spas, swimming pools, and incredibly comfortable rooms. This is considered a chill and comfortable opening of the show, true to its name, Up Poom Pak.

episodes.title: EP.2 | Stay in a luxurious hotel in the heart of the city (2/2)
episodes.synopsis: In this EP.2, we are still at the same luxurious hotel in the city center because there is something that cannot be missed in this hotel, which is the food from the Room Service and the hotel's breakfast. I can tell you that it is very good, very delicious, not to be outdone by the name of a 5-star hotel.

episodes.title: EP.3 | Cycling to see the view, walking around the floating market at "Bang Kachao"
episodes.synopsis: And then we went to the province!! But this long-awaited trip, the trip that we expected to have a beautiful relaxing experience, turned out to be a disaster victim. What will happen? Let's see.

episodes.title: EP.4 | Learning to make tie-dye shirts and handmade incense sticks
episodes.synopsis: This episode, we are still in Bang Krachao, but since we struggled a lot in EP.3, today's activity is a chill activity, going to learn how to make tie-dye shirts and incense sticks. It's a new experience for both of us. The tie-dye shirts we made will be given to the lucky winners. After watching the clip, you can join the activity.

episodes.title: EP.5 | Found it! The game where Poom was completely defeated
episodes.synopsis: After being a victim of the Bang Krachao trip, the new trip we intend to come back to "rest" comfortably again. This time, the two of us have only one day free, so we will go on a one-day trip to Pattaya. But since we finished work at 6pm the day before, we decided right then and there to sleep in Pattaya first, so we can wake up early to travel. Before going to bed, we played the "Forbidden Words" game and found out that this is a game Poom isn't good at at all lol

episodes.title: EP.6 | 1 DAY IN PATTAYA, super chill (because we were scared after Bang Kachao)
episodes.synopsis: This episode, we stayed in Pattaya for a full day. Let me tell you, this time, the two of us promised each other that we would really relax. We wouldn't be like in Bang Kachao. And then it came out as you can see. We didn't do anything at all. We just sat around and ate. But it was a good rest. Ready to go back to work.

episodes.title: EP.7 | Take Mooyong, Poom's beloved daughter, to spoil her
episodes.synopsis: This video came about because a friend of mine opened a "one-stop service" veterinary hospital called Pawsville Animal Hospital. Since I don't have any pets myself, I hadn't had the chance to use their services—but I know Poom has a cat, so I invited Mooyong (Poom's "fur-baby") to come and give it a try. This place offers a full range of services, including medical check-ups, treatments, vaccinations, bathing, haircuts, nail trimming, and even a pet hotel. There's a comfortable café where pet parents can relax while waiting, and they even offer fine dining options for the pets themselves. If you have a pet, I highly recommend checking them out!

episodes.title: EP.8 |  A Foodie Tour of Top Spots in Udon Thani
episodes.synopsis: We’ve finally arrived in Udon Thani! This is a 3 days 3 nights trip, so we're staying for a long time. If you think we're going to encounter any disaster, you're wrong! Our first day was actually super chill; we just spent the whole day leisurely eating our way through the city.

episodes.title: EP.9 | A Spiritual Trip to "Khamchanod" Udon Thani
episodes.synopsis: We're still in Udon Thani! Today, we're heading to "Khamchanod". Since Poom has been here before, he's taking on the role of tour guide for P'Chui. But before we set off, we enjoyed a delicious Vietnamese meal at VIETgetable, located right inside the Phukaning  Hotel.

episodes.title: EP.10 | UP&POOM visit DREAM WORLD amusement park
episodes.synopsis: Since so many of you mentioned wanting to see us visit an amusement park, we decided to take this opportunity to head to Dream World! And since we were going anyway, we invited P'Bruce along as a special guest. He's been saying for years that he wanted to visit Dream World, so we thought we'd make that dream come true for him. A big thank you to Dream World—it was such a fun day out. If you'd like to try the rides or visit the spots where we took photos, feel free to follow in our footsteps—and don't forget to share your own photos with us!

episodes.title: EP.11 | Mekong River Adventure: Exploring Pan God San Krai in Nong Khai Province
episodes.synopsis: In this episode, Poom and I went on a Mekong River cruise in Nong Khai province to see the Pan God San Krai (a landscape of thousands of rocky islets and shrubs). Before the cruise, we stopped by Wat Pha Tak Suea, which features a stunning viewpoint—I really recommend everyone follow in our footsteps and visit. This trip was incredibly fun; even though the weather was a bit hot, the entire journey was filled with laughter and happiness.

episodes.title: EP.12 | UpPoom make pottery as special gifts for Photobook UP&POOM BESIDE
episodes.synopsis: In this episode, we tried pottery for the very first time to create 10 special gifts for lucky buyers of the UP&POOM BESIDE photobook. I have to admit our skills aren't quite professional yet, but we poured our hearts into making these so that everyone who receives one truly feels special. We hope you will like the gifts we crafted with such care for you.
